sources.title: Qwen - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Qwen (also known as Tongyi Qianwen, Chinese: 通义千问; pinyin: Tōngyì Qiānwèn) is a family of predominantly open weights large and small language models (LLM and SLM) developed by Alibaba Cloud. Its latest version, Qwen3.8; the 2.4 trillion parameter model was the second largest and second most powerful open weights LLM and Chinese LLM released by 12 August 2026, after Kimi K3. [1][2 ...
